technical.summary: SLV shows solid trend structure with ADX confirmation and price above key moving averages, but momentum indicators are flat/declining and overbought conditions limit upside probability for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: SLV shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; suitable only for technical or macro-driven silver exposure strategies.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; extreme fear (37/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but stale trades (2+ years old) and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (224) indicates extreme market stress; falling DXY provides modest commodity tailwind but insufficient to offset systemic risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX trending confirmation (7.0 tech score), price above key moving averages, and Ichimoku cloud breakout provide structural uptrend evidence with DXY tailwind supporting commodity strength.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought momentum (RSI 79.41, Williams %R overbought), flat RSI divergence despite bullish levels, macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 224), below-average volume (0.6 ratio), and price below 200-EMA create high-risk entry with limited upside probability.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical trend structure (ADX, Ichimoku) shows valid uptrend, but overbought momentum divergence and macro crisis conditions create asymmetric risk-reward unfavorable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve + VIX 224 crisis levels signal systemic stress; overbought RSI (79.41) with flat momentum divergence increases probability of mean reversion pullback into existing support.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents all converge on bear case despite moderate tech score
